ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 40% high-intensity (white) pixels on the left lobe and 60% low-intensity (black) pixels across the center and right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric blob occupying the inner-left lobe; predominantly black right lobe with concentrated white mottling/stippling along the trailing edge and midline. Peduncle area displays high-frequency white-on-black speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated 40-50 degree vertex angle and a depth approximately 1/6th the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the left trailing edge; the right trailing edge displays a more irregular, jagged topography with localized peaks near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edges of both lobes leading toward the center, with the left lobe exhibiting a more pronounced upward convexity on its distal leading edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of circular white high-contrast spots on the lower right fluke surface and peduncle base, characteristic of barnacle attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, parallel dark linear pixel disruptions crossing the high-intensity white field on the upper-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular indentation or 'chunk' missing from the trailing edge of the left lobe near the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharp, near-vertical binary division between the white left lobe pigment and the black central/right fluke pigment.
